Looking for a porta cabin in Madurai? SAMAN manufactures steel porta cabins and ships them ready-to-use to sites across Madurai from our Bangalore factory. The road distance is about 440 km, so a finished unit usually reaches your site in 3 to 5 days. You get a single-room steel cabin â€” site office, security post, rest room, or store â€” built to size, wired, and finished before it leaves the factory. No on-site construction, no waiting for masonry to cure.

SAMAN has been making prefab steel structures since 2009 and runs two factories â€” Bangalore for South India and Greater Noida for the North. Madurai is served fully from Bangalore. If you want to see our porta cabins before fixing a size, the spec sheets and photos are all there.

Why buyers in Madurai choose SAMAN

Madurai is southern Tamil Nadu's commercial and industrial centre â€” the trade hub for the whole southern districts. The granite and stone units around the city, the textile and rubber industries, the warehousing on the Madurai–Tuticorin belt, the construction near the airport and ring road, and the steady institutional building work â€” all of it needs movable, ready-to-use workspace. A porta cabin gives you that without tying up land or building a permanent structure for a temporary need.

We build to order, not from stock. Your cabin is sized for your site, finished in the colour you want, and fitted with the electrical points and windows you actually need. As a manufacturer we control the steel, the panels, and the finish in-house, so what we quote is what we build. SAMAN holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 certification, with 500+ projects delivered across India. See the porta cabin solutions we build to this standard.

Local industries in Madurai that use porta cabins

Madurai's demand spreads across its industrial estates and the southern trade corridors:

  • SIDCO Industrial Estate, Kappalur (625008) â€” engineering, rubber, and small manufacturing units use porta cabins as supervisor offices and store rooms.
  • Vadipatti and the granite belt (625218) â€” stone and granite processing units use them as site offices and weighbridge cabins.
  • Thiruparankundram and the NH-44 corridor â€” logistics and warehousing operators use them as gate and security cabins on the highway belt.
  • Madurai Airport and ring-road construction â€” contractors use them as on-site project offices that move with the work.

For any site from Kappalur to the ring road, a single truck delivers and places the cabin in a day.

Specifications and sizes

Every SAMAN porta cabin is built on a welded MS steel frame using IS 2062 grade hollow sections. The standard build:

  • Frame: mild steel hollow section, welded and anti-rust treated
  • Wall panels: PUF insulated sandwich panel or cement fibre board â€” PUF helps against Madurai's strong summer heat
  • Roof: GI sheet or colour-coated profile sheet with slope for rain runoff
  • Flooring: marine ply, cement board, or vinyl over a steel base
  • Doors and windows: powder-coated steel or aluminium, positioned to your layout

Sizes run from a compact 6Ã—8 ft security cabin up to 20Ã—8 ft and 40Ã—8 ft office units, with multi-room layouts available. For full construction detail and finish options, see the prefabricated porta cabin product page â€” the build most Madurai site offices use. Any size in between is made to order.

Customisation options

Tell us how the cabin will be used and we build around it:

  • Split AC points and extra power sockets â€” useful in Madurai's hot, dry summer
  • Internal partitions for a separate cabin or meeting room
  • Toilet and washbasin block built into the unit
  • Extra windows or a glass front for a reception or sales cabin
  • Loft storage above the ceiling line
  • Anti-skid flooring for workshop or wet areas

Price guidance

A porta cabin price in Madurai depends on the size, the wall panel you choose (cement board is economical, PUF panel costs more but insulates better against the heat), the interior fit-out, and the transport distance to your exact site. Because every unit is made to order, we confirm a firm price at quotation once we know your size and use â€” no hidden add-ons after.

Delivery and installation to Madurai

Your cabin is built and finished at our Bangalore factory, then trucked to Madurai â€” typically 3 to 5 days from dispatch. Smaller units arrive fully assembled and are craned into position in a few hours. Larger or multi-room units arrive in sections and are bolted together on site by our team. You need a level base â€” a plinth, a concrete pad, or compacted ground â€” ready before delivery.

We deliver across Tamil Nadu and the wider South from the same factory. If you are comparing options for a nearby site, you can also see our porta cabin in Kochi and porta cabin in Mangalore pages.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a porta cabin cost in Madurai?

The price depends on size, panel type, and fit-out. A small security cabin costs far less than a fully fitted office unit. We confirm the exact figure at quotation once we know your requirement.

How long does delivery to Madurai take?

Usually 3 to 5 days from dispatch out of our Bangalore factory, since the road distance is about 440 km.

Do you deliver to the southern districts around Madurai?

Yes. Madurai is our base for the southern Tamil Nadu districts, and we serve the surrounding belt from the same Bangalore factory.

Can the porta cabin be moved later?

Yes. It is a bolted steel structure â€” it can be lifted, loaded, and relocated when your site work moves.

What sizes are available?

From a 6Ã—8 ft single cabin up to 40Ã—8 ft office units and larger multi-room layouts, all made to order.

Get a quote for your porta cabin in Madurai

Tell us your size, use, and site location and we will send a clear quote. For Bangalore and South India, call +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440, or send an enquiry through the form and our team will get back to you.
